# Node.js Driver - (current)

> Learn how to connect to and interact with data stored in MongoDB by using JavaScript or TypeScript with the Node.js driver.

- [Aggregation Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/aggregation.md)
- [Aggregation Pipeline Stages](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/aggregation/pipeline-stages.md): Learn the different possible stages of the aggregation pipeline in the Node.js Driver.
- [Run a MongoDB Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/atlas-search.md): Learn about how to use MongoDB Search in the MongoDB Node.js driver.
- [Run a MongoDB Vector Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/atlas-vector-search.md)
- [Connect to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect.md): Learn how to use the Node.js driver to create a MongoClient object, configure connection options, connect to MongoDB deployments, and troubleshoot connections.
- [Specify Connection Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/connection-options.md): Explore the MongoDB Node.js Driver's connection and authentication options, including app name, authentication mechanism, and TLS configuration settings.
- [Manage Connections with Connection Pools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/connection-options/connection-pools.md)
- [Limit Server Execution Time](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/connection-options/csot.md)
- [Network Compression](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/connection-options/network-compression.md): Enable network compression in the MongoDB Node.js Driver to reduce data transfer using Snappy, Zlib, or Zstandard algorithms.
- [Stable API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/connection-options/stable-api.md): Learn how to use Stable API with the MongoDB Node.js Driver to ensure compatibility with a specified API version, preventing backward compatibility issues.
- [Choose a Connection Target](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/connection-targets.md)
- [Connection Troubleshooting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/connection-troubleshooting.md): Troubleshoot MongoDB Node.js Driver connection issues by checking connection strings, firewalls, and your `maxPoolSize` and `connectTimeoutMS` settings.
- [Create a MongoClient](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/mongoclient.md): Learn how to create a connection string, create a MongoClient object, and optimize the performance of concurrent MongoDB operations in the Node.js driver.
- [Multiple Connections in a Single Application](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/multiple-connections.md): Learn how to use multiple MongoDB connections in a single Node.js application by using Mongoose.
- [CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud.md): Learn how to use Node.js driver to read and write MongoDB data.
- [Bulk Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/bulk-write.md): Learn how to perform bulk operations by using the MongoDB Node.js driver.
- [Compound Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/compound-operations.md): Learn how to use compound operations with the MongoDB Node.js Driver for atomic actions by using methods like findOneAndDelete() and findOneAndUpdate().
- [Configure CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/configure.md)
- [Delete Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/delete.md): Learn how to use deleteOne() and deleteMany() methods in the MongoDB Node.js Driver to remove documents from a collection based on specified query criteria.
- [Store Large Files with GridFS](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/gridfs.md): Learn how to use GridFS and the MongoDB Node.js Driver to store and retrieve large files, and learn how to upload, download, rename, and delete files.
- [Insert Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/insert.md): Learn how to insert single or multiple documents into a MongoDB collection using the MongoDB Node.js Driver, with examples of handling unique _id constraints.
- [Generate Custom Values for _id](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/pkFactory.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB Node.js Driver to generate custom _id values with a primary key factory during insert operations.
- [Query Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query.md): Learn how to use Node.js driver to read data from MongoDB.
- [Count Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/count.md): Learn how to count documents in a collection using the MongoDB Node.js driver.
- [Access Data From a Cursor](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/cursor.md): Learn how to access data from a cursor in the MongoDB Node.js Driver by using paradigms like asynchronous and manual iteration, while managing resources.
- [Retrieve Distinct Values](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/distinct.md)
- [Search Geospatially](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/geo.md): Learn how to use query operators to perform geospatial queries with the MongoDB Node.js Driver for both Earth-like sphere and 2D plane coordinate systems.
- [Specify Which Fields to Return](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/project.md): Use projections with the MongoDB Node.js Driver to specify fields to return in query results, optimizing network bandwidth by including or excluding fields.
- [Specify a Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/query-document.md): Learn how to query documents with the MongoDB Node.js Driver by using comparison, logical, element, and evaluation operators to filter collection documents.
- [Find Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/retrieve.md): Learn how to retrieve data, aggregate data, and monitor data changes in MongoDB by using the Node.js driver.
- [Specify Documents to Return](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/specify-documents-to-return.md)
- [Query Text](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/query/text.md): Perform text queries with the MongoDB Node.js Driver using the $text operator to find documents with specified words or phrases, and sort results by relevance.
- [Transactions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/transactions.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB Node.js Driver to perform transactions, ensuring atomicity and ACID compliance for multi-document operations.
- [Use the Convenient Transaction API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/transactions/transaction-conv.md): Perform a transaction using the Convenient Transaction API with the MongoDB Node.js Driver to update data atomically.
- [Use the Core API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/transactions/transaction-core.md): Use the Core API with the MongoDB Node.js Driver to update multiple documents in a single transaction.
- [Update Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/update.md): Learn how to use the upsert option in the MongoDB Node.js Driver, which inserts or updates documents in a single operation based on whether they exist.
- [Update Arrays in a Document](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/update/embedded-arrays.md): Learn how to use array update operators in the MongoDB Node.js Driver to modify embedded arrays in documents, including positional operators.
- [Modify Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/update/modify.md): Modify documents in a collection using update and replace operations in the MongoDB Node.js Driver using updateOne(), updateMany(), and replaceOne() methods.
- [Replace Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/crud/update/replace.md)
- [Specialized Data Formats](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/data-formats.md)
- [Work with BSON Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/data-formats/bson.md)
- [Undefined Values](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/data-formats/bson/undefined-values.md): Learn to control the serialization of undefined values in MongoDB Node.js Driver by using the ignoreUndefined setting at various levels.
- [UTF-8 Validation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/data-formats/bson/utf8-validation.md): Learn how to enable or disable UTF-8 validation in the MongoDB Node.js Driver to manage data encoding and processing overhead.
- [Work with Extended JSON Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/data-formats/extended-json.md)
- [Time Series](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/data-formats/time-series.md): Learn about creating and querying time series collections using the MongoDB Node.js Driver.
- [Databases and Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/databases-collections.md)
- [Get Started with the Node.js Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/get-started.md): Learn how to create an app to connect to MongoDB deployment by using the Node.js driver.
- [MongoDB Node.js Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/index.md): Learn how to connect to and interact with data stored in MongoDB by using JavaScript or TypeScript with the Node.js driver.
- [Indexes for Query Optimization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/indexes.md): Explore how to create and manage various types of indexes with the MongoDB Node.js Driver to optimize query performance and support efficient data retrieval.
- [Third-Party Integrations and Tools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/integrations.md)
- [Tutorial: Use MongoDB with Azure Functions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/integrations/azure-functions.md): Learn how to build an HTTP-triggered Azure Function that queries MongoDB Atlas by using the Node.js driver, and deploy your application to the Azure cloud.
- [Integrate with Mongoose](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/integrations/mongoose.md): Learn about Mongoose, an Object Data Modeling (ODM) library for MongoDB, and how it compares to the MongoDB Node.js driver.
- [Tutorial: Mongoose Get Started](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/integrations/mongoose/mongoose-get-started.md): Learn how to create an app to connect to MongoDB and perform CRUD operations by using Mongoose.
- [Tutorial: Queryable Encryption with Mongoose](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/integrations/mongoose/mongoose-qe.md): Learn how to implement Queryable Encryption with Mongoose for automatic field encryption and decryption.
- [Tutorial: Deploy a Next.js Application on Vercel](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/integrations/next-vercel.md): Learn how to build a basic application with Next.js that connects to MongoDB, and deploy your application on Vercel, a platform for hosting web applications.
- [Tutorial: Integrate with Prisma](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/integrations/prisma.md): Learn how to connect a Node.js application using Prisma to a MongoDB database.
- [Issues & Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/issues-and-help.md): Find support for MongoDB Node.js Driver issues through community forums, report bugs or request features in JIRA, and create pull requests to contribute.
- [Monitoring and Logging](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/monitoring-and-logging.md): Learn how to monitor and log events by using the MongoDB Node.js driver.
- [Monitor Data with Change Streams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/monitoring-and-logging/change-streams.md): Use the MongoDB Node.js Driver to monitor changes to collections, databases, or clients by opening a change stream, and learn how to handle change events.
- [Logging](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/monitoring-and-logging/logging.md): Learn about the severity levels of different MongoDB events, and how to use the Node.js driver to configure the location and length of the logged messages.
- [Monitor Application Events](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/monitoring-and-logging/monitoring.md): Learn how to set up and configure monitoring in the MongoDB Node.js driver to track command events, Server Discovery and Monitoring (SDAM) events, and connection pool events.
- [Use Promises with Asynchronous JavaScript](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/promises.md): Learn to use promises for MongoDB Node.js Driver asynchronous operations, such as success and failure state handling, chaining, and using the await operation.
- [Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/reference.md)
- [Quick Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/reference/quick-reference.md): See Node.js driver code examples of frequently-used MongoDB commands and links to their related reference and API documentation.
- [Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/reference/release-notes.md): Discover the latest features and updates of the in the MongoDB Node.js Driver.
- [Upgrade Driver Versions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/reference/upgrade.md): Upgrade your MongoDB Node.js Driver version by ensuring compatibility, addressing breaking changes, and using the Stable API to minimize application changes.
- [Run a Database Command](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/run-command.md): Learn about how to run database commands by using the MongoDB Node.js driver, including options and response handling.
- [Secure Your Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security.md): Learn how to use Node.js driver to secure your data.
- [Authentication Mechanisms](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/authentication.md): Authenticate using the MongoDB Node.js Driver with various supported authentication mechanisms.
- [AWS IAM Authentication Mechanism](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/authentication/aws-iam.md)
- [Kerberos (GSSAPI) Authentication Mechanism](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/authentication/kerberos.md)
- [LDAP (PLAIN) Authentication Mechanism](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/authentication/ldap.md)
- [OIDC Authentication Mechanism](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/authentication/oidc.md): Explore sample code for connecting to MongoDB using enterprise authentication mechanisms like Kerberos, LDAP, and MONGODB-OIDC with the MongoDB Node.js Driver.
- [SCRAM Authentication Mechanisms](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/authentication/scram.md)
- [X.509 Authentication Mechanism](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/authentication/x509.md)
- [In-Use Encryption](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/encrypt-fields.md): Encrypt specific document fields using in-use encryption with the MongoDB Node.js Driver to protect sensitive data before sending it to MongoDB.
- [Enable SOCKS5 Proxy Support](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/socks.md): Learn how to connect to MongoDB using a SOCKS5 proxy by configuring the MongoDB Node.js Driver with the necessary proxy options.
- [Enable TLS on a Connection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/tls.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB Node.js Driver to connect to MongoDB instances with TLS by using the TLS option and providing certificates for secure connections.
- [TypeScript Features and Limitations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/typescript.md): Explore using TypeScript with the MongoDB Node.js Driver, including type parameters, type safety, and handling the _id field.
